summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical filed an 8-K disclosing an October 8, 2026 asset purchase agreement to sell a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher to an unnamed buyer for $203 million in cash at closing. The PRV was awarded by the FDA on September 17, 2026 upon approval of FAYUVI (UX111) for MPS IIIA. Closing is subject to customary conditions, including expiration or termination of the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, covenants and indemnification; the full text will be filed with the 2026 Form 10-K. Watch HSR clearance timing and cash deployment versus pipeline spending.
